posts.title: ASCO: 5-year melanoma follow-up keeps Phase 3 window in view
posts.text: Moderna and Merck present 5-year KEYNOTE-942 data for intismeran autogene plus Keytruda in resected high-risk melanoma. Risk of recurrence or death still lower vs Keytruda alone. Phase 3 INTerpath-001 fully enrolled; readout expected in 2026. $MRNA $MRK
posts.author: @teaching

posts.title: Street: 5-year data is confidence into 2026 Phase 3, not the Phase 3
posts.text: Jefferies: 5-year survival figures help instill confidence in pivotal Phase 3 data in 2026. This is not a top-line print. $MRNA $MRK
